conflictLens.description: Visualize files and lines that may conflict with the base branch.
conflictLens.command.enable.title: Enable
conflictLens.command.disable.title: Disable
conflictLens.command.toggle.title: Toggle
conflictLens.command.refresh.title: Refresh
conflictLens.config.remoteName.descripti: Remote name used as the prefix for auto-detection candidates (<remoteName>/HEAD, <remoteName>/main, <remoteName>/master). Defaults to 'origin'.
conflictLens.config.showOverviewRuler.de: Show markers in the editor overview ruler.
conflictLens.config.showFileDecorationBa: Show badges on file names that the base branch has changed.
conflictLens.config.remoteCheckIntervalM: Interval in minutes for polling remote updates with git ls-remote. Set to 0 to disable.
conflictLens.color.changedLineBackground: Background color for lines changed on the base branch.
conflictLens.capabilities.untrustedWorks: Conflict Lens executes git commands and reads workspace settings, so it requires a trusted workspace.
